Tara (partnerships): kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). scope: publisher creds, SKU & meter mapping, legal artifacts, assets + quickstart. short answers please.
Ben (product): I can own SKU mapping and pricing tiers. will make labels match billing.
Clara (legal): taking EULA + publisher agreement. need to know trial limits and telemetry plan.
Diego (eng-ops): creds and IAM templates. will need infra to provision roles/service accounts.
Eve (devex): quickstart, terraform examples, and screenshots. will avoid real secrets in samples.
marketplace-bot: Created TASK-5310: marketplace-onboard. assignee: Tara. due_in: 72h.
Tara (partnerships): trial proposal? Ben?
Ben (product): propose 7k trial tokens, 14 days, API-key rate limit 60/min default.
Clara (legal): ok on trial. will add a clause about non-commercial/no scraping. telemetry must be opt-in.
Eve (devex): will add `enable_marketplace_telemetry=false` example and show opt-in flow.
Diego (eng-ops): placeholder creds:
- aws role: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-marketplace-pub
- gcp sa: redwood-marketplace@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- azure appId: 22222222-3333-4444-5555-666666666666
I'll replace after infra creates them.
Tara (partnerships): assets: hero 1200x600 + thumbnail 600x300 + 2 screenshots. Eve please upload to shared drive.
Eve (devex): on it. also adding a short FAQ on data residency and KMS options.
Ben (product): meter names for billing:
- redwood.tokens
- redwood.embeddings
- redwood.trial_tokens
I'll post spreadsheet.
Clara (legal): include links to privacy policy and SOC/ISO page. add contact legal@redwood.ai for publisher agreements.
marketplace-bot: Reminder TASK-5310 check-in in 48h.
Tara (partnerships): timeline: get ready for sandbox upload in 3 business days. update this thread with links to artifacts. thanks all!
